channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Free trade pact with New Zealand India's first women-led FTA: PM Modi
item.description: PM Modi shared an article written by Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal, which explains that India's FTAs today go well beyond tariff reductions, forming part of a broader mission to strengthen the economy and improve the lives of millions.

item.title: 22 Maoists, carrying total Rs 1.48 crore reward, surrender in Odisha
item.description: The surrendered Maoist cadres carried a combined reward of around Rs 1.48 crore, according to the Malkangiri Police sources. The cadres also surrendered nine firearms, comprising one AK-47 rifle, two INSAS rifles, one SLR rifle, three .303 rifles, and two single-shot rifles.

item.title: Arunachal Police arrest two from Kashmir for espionage linked to Pakistan
item.description: "The accused, during their visits to Arunachal Pradesh, were allegedly collecting sensitive information from people in different parts of the state and sharing it with their Pakistani handlers," the official told the media.

item.title: Crime Branch busts Rs 4.3 crore racket selling expired imported food with fake labels across India
item.description: Acting on specific intelligence, the Cyber Cell of the Crime Branch conducted raids in Pahari Dheeraj and Faiz Ganj areas of Sadar Bazar, a major wholesale hub in the capital. "During the operation, seven persons, including the main mastermind, were apprehended, and huge quantities of expired international food products were recovered from shops and godowns," the Delhi Police said in its press note.

item.title: NIA court attaches US-based separatist Dr Fai's property in J&K's Budgam
item.description: An NIA court in J&K has ordered the attachment of immovable property belonging to US-based Kashmiri separatist Ghulam Nabi Shah alias Dr Fai under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The order follows his failure to appear before investigators after being declared a proclaimed offender in a terror-related case.

item.title: Minimum temperature slips below zero in Gulmarg, Pahalgam; rises in J&K's Srinagar
item.description: Jammu city had 8.2 degrees Celsius, Katra town 9.4, Batote 4.2, Banihal 6.4 and Bhaderwah 0.6 degrees as the minimum temperature. The MeT department has forecast dry weather till December 31 across the union territory, saying that the minimum temperature is likely to drop due to a clear night sky.

item.title: FTAs to unlock global markets for Indian professional services: Govt
item.description: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal emphasised the importance of enhanced stakeholder coordination, reforms in the domestic ecosystem, and legally binding commitments on professional services under various FTAs.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty record mild gains amid positive global cues
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex advanced 105 points, or 0.12 per cent to 85,630 and Nifty gained 40 points, or 0.16 per cent to 26,217.Main broad-cap indices outperformed benchmark indices in terms of gains, with the Nifty Midcap 100 advanced 0.31 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 added 0.53 per cent.

item.title: Gold, silver surpass record high amid US‑Venezuela tensions, Fed rate cut hopes
item.description: MCX gold February futures rose 0.44 per cent to Rs 1,38,485 per 10 grams, while MCX silver surged 1.79 per cent to a record high of Rs 2,23,593 per kilogram (as of 10.05 am).

item.title: PM Modi lauds launch of 'BlueBird 6', calls it 'significant stride' in India's space sector
item.description: In a post on X, PM Modi said, "A significant stride in India's space sector... The successful LVM3-M6 launch, placing the heaviest satellite ever launched from Indian soil, the spacecraft of USA, BlueBird Block-2, into its intended orbit, marks a proud milestone in India's space journey."
